description: This file defines the SaleReturn controller class for the admin reporting extension in OpenCart. It handles displaying, saving settings, and generating reports for sale returns, including rendering views, managing URLs, and interacting with models.

classes.name: SaleReturn
classes.description: Controller class for managing sale return reports in the OpenCart admin panel, including displaying report forms, saving settings, and generating report data.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads language, sets page title, prepares breadcrumb navigation, and renders the sales return report form view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving of report settings, with permission check, and returns success or error message in JSON.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Prepares and displays the sales return report view, including return statuses and grouping options.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Outputs the report list by calling getReport method.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Generates and returns the sales return report data in HTML view format, including handling filters, pagination, and calling related models.
